items.title: John "Picky" Brunious Interview, 1959-05-26
items.q: You remember Judge Raleigh? Well, he was the drummer.

ctx.x: Cleo, you remember Cleo? No. Cleo, well, uh, well, he got killed during the war. He, uh, he, he, he was another guy who never could read, you know? But, boy, he was a wonderful bass player, but never could read and just play anything. I mean, he was one, boy, you used to take that bass, and he was one of the first ones around here to take that bass and lay it down and, play it and play it and, and all that kind of humbug, you know? People used to go wild over him, but he acted a good player though. Yeah. See?…
I was wondering about how big a band would come to develop.
